data.name: Hope
data.gender_notes: Hope is used as a female name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Old English hopian, 'to hope', a Christian virtue name. Its root is Old English hopian. A virtue name from the Christian theological virtue of hope (1 Corinthians 13:13). Hope is a English name meaning “Hope; expectation”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Hope expresses “Hope; expectation”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Old English hopian, 'to hope', a Christian virtue name.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hope total 26, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.
